text: {"lessons":["I should avoid reactive selling based on losses or short-term price moves; each trade needs a forward-looking reason, not just a desire to undo a past decision.","I should make additions deliberately and manage position sizes across the portfolio, rather than letting a sequence of buys concentrate risk without a clear plan.","My account has risen recently, but ten periods are too short to judge skill; I should track performance against a suitable benchmark over a longer horizon and stick to a consistent process."]}
